# GENERATED by scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.py from
# scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.json -- edit the catalog, not this file.
# Reader roster for selected books. The global index is populated on mastery.
# A player's older-save mastery is indexed when that player opens a roster.

kehillah_lib_readers_work_targum_onkelos = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		clear_variable_list = kehillah_lib_readers
		kehillah_lib_index_yeshiva_readers_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_readers_work_id value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
				NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_sefer_masters target = this } }
			}
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_sefer_masters target = this }
		}
		save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_viewer
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_sefer_masters
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
				OR = {
					has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait
					has_trait = lifestyle_scholar
					kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes
				}
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
			}
			save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_candidate
			scope:kehillah_lib_reader_viewer = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_lib_readers target = scope:kehillah_lib_reader_candidate }
			}
		}
	}
}

			variable = kehillah_sefer_masters
			limit = {

					has_trait = lifestyle_scholar
					kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes
				}
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_nashim }
			}
			save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_candidate

				add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_lib_readers target = scope:kehillah_lib_reader_candidate }
			}
		}

kehillah_lib_readers_work_authored_26 = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		clear_variable_list = kehillah_lib_readers
		kehillah_lib_index_yeshiva_readers_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_readers_work_id value = 69 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_26 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_sefer_masters target = this } }
			}
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_sefer_masters target = this }
		}
		save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_viewer
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_sefer_masters
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
				OR = {
					has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait
					has_trait = lifestyle_scholar
					kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes
				}
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_26 }
			}
			save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_candidate
			scope:kehillah_lib_reader_viewer = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_lib_readers target = scope:kehillah_lib_reader_candidate }
			}
		}
	}
}

kehillah_lib_readers_loaded_work_authored_26 = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { has_variable = kehillah_lib_readers_work_id var:kehillah_lib_readers_work_id = 69 }
}

		kehillah_lib_index_yeshiva_readers_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_readers_work_id value = 124 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_81 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_sefer_masters target = this } }
			}
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_sefer_masters target = this }
		}
		save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_viewer
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_sefer_masters
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
				OR = {
					has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait
					has_trait = lifestyle_scholar
					kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes
				}
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_81 }
			}
			save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_candidate
			scope:kehillah_lib_reader_viewer = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_lib_readers target = scope:kehillah_lib_reader_candidate }
			}
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { has_variable = kehillah_lib_readers_work_id var:kehillah_lib_readers_work_id = 137 }
}

kehillah_lib_readers_work_authored_95 = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		clear_variable_list = kehillah_lib_readers
		kehillah_lib_index_yeshiva_readers_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_readers_work_id value = 138 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_95 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_sefer_masters target = this } }
			}
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_sefer_masters target = this }
		}
		save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_viewer
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = kehillah_sefer_masters
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
				OR = {
					has_trait = kehillah_rabbi_trait
					has_trait = lifestyle_scholar
					kehillah_is_karaite_character_trigger = yes
				}
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_authored_95 }
			}
			save_scope_as = kehillah_lib_reader_candidate
			scope:kehillah_lib_reader_viewer = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_lib_readers target = scope:kehillah_lib_reader_candidate }
			}
		}
	}
}

kehillah_lib_readers_loaded_work_authored_95 = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { has_variable = kehillah_lib_readers_work_id var:kehillah_lib_readers_work_id = 138 }
}
